items.title: Updates without the setup wizard
items.text: On Windows, an update from Settings › Version now installs in ClipCut's own small window and opens the new version by itself. No more clicking through the installer.

items.title: CapCut template links
items.text: Paste a CapCut template's share link on the launch screen and press Import template. You get a project in the template's size, with its music on its own track, its cuts laid out as slots, and its flashes and fades as ClipCut transitions.

items.title: Replace clip
items.text: Right-click a clip and choose Replace clip… to put a file of your own in its exact place and length. On a template slot, a photo works too.

items.title: Templates
items.text: Save any project as a template, and open the Templates tab in the media panel to start a new project from one. Its slots show what goes where until you replace them.

items.title: Updates arrive sooner
items.text: Windows updates are published as soon as they are built, without waiting for the Mac versions.
